name: Sales Call
description: Customer needs, objections, buying signals and the agreed next step.
outline: Summarize who the prospect is and why they were talking to us, as far as stated.
List the needs and pain points the customer described, in their own words where possible.
List objections or concerns and how they were answered.
Note buying signals, budget, timeline and who decides, if mentioned.
End with the agreed next step, its owner and date.
Keep it factual: never add information that is not in the transcript, and omit a section when nothing applies.
example:
## Needs
- Wants to cut manual reporting

## Next Step
Send the proposal by Thursday (Lena).
